chinese.query_selection: First 128 query IDs ordered by SHA256 of UTF-8 string public-retrieval-v1:query: followed by unmodified original query ID; ties by original ID
chinese.corpus_selection: Union of all documents with any published qrel for a selected query and first 2048 remaining documents ordered by SHA256 of UTF-8 string public-retrieval-v1:distractor: followed by original document ID; ties by original ID
chinese.qrels: Preserve all published grades for selected queries. Evaluator expected set includes score > 0 only.
chinese.limitations: Reduced corpus and query subset; neither official full C-MTEB score nor broad Chinese release certification. No inferred negative labels.

text_policy: Unmodified source text; English nonempty title is prepended with one newline. No generated content, paraphrase, numeric substitutions or label additions.

descriptive_tags.query_numeric: ASCII digit occurs in original query
descriptive_tags.relevant_doc_long: At least one positive-qrel source document after title prepend has >= 2000 Unicode code points
descriptive_tags.relevant_doc_numeric: ASCII digit occurs in at least one positive-qrel source document
